unit.why: A medieval legend about Nahmanides and his apostate disciple Avner; it is not Hasidic.

stories.start_quote: מעשה ברמב״ן ז"ל שהי׳ לו תלמיד
stories.summary_en: Nahmanides' disciple Avner apostatizes, becomes a great lord and eats pork before his master on Yom Kippur; the Ramban finds Avner's name hinted in Parashat Haazinu, Avner repents and sets out to sea in a boat without a crew, and the Ramban's prayers later win his soul partial atonement, as his mother reveals in a dream.
